name: Air Pollution Control Engineering
description: Major pollutants and quantification. Spark ignited (SI) and compression ignition (CI) engines. Thermodynamics, mechanisms, and kinetics of pollutant formation. Measurement of emissions and standards. Fuel properties and norms. Impact of fuel on emissions. Catalytic aftertreatment. Modeling of catalytic converter. Technology advancements in catalytic aftertreatment. Reduction of gaseous emissions from diesel engines – diesel oxidation catalyst (DOC), selective catalytic reduction (SCR), lean NOx trap (LNT), passive NOx adsorber (PNA), diesel particulate filter, integrated commercial system designs, aftertreatment for alternative fuels: CNG, DME. Pollution control from stationary sources.
